capabilities.description: Assess whether AGDF is proportionate and recommend the lightest safe path.
Use repository files, durable control state and local validation where the Codex host grants the required access.
Lifecycle hooks are a Codex-specific enhancement and remain host-trust-dependent.

Fit assessment, explanation, planning and review use skills whose checked bundle satisfies AGDF's reviewed core-format profile and resolves declared shared resources within the plugin; standalone installation and host behavior remain unverified.
The initial release provides no AGDF-operated MCP server, hosted account or service authentication.
